overview: The Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to establish the Community Preservation Committee and requested a legal inquiry into the sale of the former Malden Hospital site. Members also addressed reports of unremitted employee insurance premiums and heard an update from the Mayor regarding FAA flight path noise.

items.title: Mayor's Update on FAA Flight Noise
items.summary: Mayor Burke reported on a meeting regarding FAA flight path noise impacts on Medford neighborhoods and announced new appointments to the Massport and Logan Airport Community Advisory Committees.

items.title: Dom's Motor Service Permits
items.summary: Approved a special permit and a Class II auto dealer's license for Dom's Motor Service to relocate used vehicle and motorcycle sales to 83 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Malden Hospital Site Sale Inquiry
items.summary: Referred a request to the City Solicitor to determine if the sale of the former hospital site to a private developer is subject to review by the state Attorney General under laws governing nonprofit asset disposal.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Ordinance
items.summary: Passed the first reading of an ordinance establishing the Community Preservation Committee to oversee local projects funded by the recently adopted CPA.

items.title: Clippership Connector Project Presentation
items.summary: Requested that the administration provide a presentation on the Clippership Connector community path project to address concerns from neighboring property owners.

items.title: MBTA and Pedestrian Safety Resolutions
items.summary: Referred safety concerns regarding the MBTA bus stop at Main and High Streets to the transportation subcommittee and requested that the DCR replace a damaged pedestrian signal near Whole Foods.

items.title: City Employee AFLAC Premium Discrepancies
items.summary: Requested an investigation into why the city allegedly failed to remit employee-paid insurance premiums to AFLAC since March 2016 despite payroll deductions.

items.title: Meeting Records and LED Lighting Update
items.summary: Approved past meeting minutes and reviewed a status report on the proposed $99,999 project to retrofit Medford Square and other business districts with LED lighting.
